# Secondary Technologies, on the page of the first school that can advance (as its tab button opens it).
DA_AM_open_school_page = {
	DA_initialise_interface_variables = yes
	DA_open_main_tech_interface = yes
	DA_tech_interface_close_tabs_effect = yes
	if = { limit = { DA_AM_school_ready_Metallurgy = yes } DA_open_metallurgy_interface = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { DA_AM_school_ready_Magic_Theory = yes } DA_open_arcane_arts_interface = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { DA_AM_school_ready_Mechanics = yes } DA_open_mechanics_interface = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { DA_AM_school_ready_Alchemy = yes } DA_open_alchemy_interface = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { DA_AM_school_ready_Medicine = yes } DA_open_medicine_interface = yes }
	else = { DA_open_metallurgy_interface = yes }
	export_to_variable = { value = modifier:DA_fake_alloy_common_slot_adder variable_name = DA_alloy_common_slots }
	export_to_variable = { value = modifier:DA_fake_alloy_rare_slot_adder variable_name = DA_alloy_rare_slots }
	export_to_variable = { value = modifier:DA_fake_alloy_legendary_slot_adder variable_name = DA_alloy_legendary_slots }
}
